_about: Where REELIX finds its free local models. scripts/setup.sh installs them under {models} (default ~/.reelix). A laptop can override any value in config/models.local.json (not in git), e.g. to use models that already live in another folder: scripts/setup.sh --use-existing <folder>.

videoWan.engine: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B, FastWan DMD 3-step MLX (Apache-2.0, commercial OK); runs with mlx-video (MIT)
videoWan.about: 3D AI motion look: animates each shot's picture (~2 min motion + ~10 min tiled decode per 3-4 s clip on a 16 GB Mac). Download: lBroth/FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B-MLX (24 GB).

upscale.engine: Real-ESRGAN ncnn-vulkan v0.2.5.0, model realesr-animevideov3 (BSD-3, commercial OK)
upscale.about: AI motion look: sharpens Wan clips (480x832) before they are scaled to full size, ~25 s per 3 s clip. Download: github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN releases, realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan-20220424-macos.zip

cutout.about: REELIX's own Apple Vision cut-out (tools/cutout.swift), built by tools/cutout.sh on first use

imageKlein.engine: FLUX.2 klein 4B (Apache-2.0; the 9B is non-commercial, never use it)
